title: Gold’s Rate Problem Turns Technical as 4,230 Fibonacci Support Gives Way
summary: Gold broke below 4,200 on Monday after taking out 4,234.68 and the 61.8% retracement at 4,230.70, turning a persistent oil-to-rates headwind into technical damage. 4,113.82 is the next momentum test, and 3,937.19–3,942.43 is the larger structural verdict.
